historical_access_scope: Existing receipts document zero reserved access; no external custody audit proves universal historical nonaccess. This is a newly locked current-run execution.
source_models: five independently trained ResNet18 checkpoints with distinct initial and final tensor hashes; no retraining or checkpoint selection
source_geography: 14 source cities; source-only normalizer; whole-block monitor split
controller_development: already opened 9-city 45-cell Tent evidence only; exact existing v2 controller replay

calibration.residual: maximum over five checkpoints per city

target.labels: testing labels once after complete sealed actions and prediction inventory

inference.tests: exact city sign flip under independent joint sign symmetry; Holm .05 over two primary comparisons
inference.intervals: nominal 95 percent city-cluster percentile bootstrap under the existing v2 fixed seed and resample count
inference.calibration_scope: 90 percent marginal simultaneous five-checkpoint coverage for one exchangeable new city before data-dependent selection; culture-shift exchangeability is not established
inference.conditional_risk_claim: none: even zero errors in 19 independent cities gives 95 percent one-sided upper risk greater than .10

preaccess: new protocol and input/code identities locked before calibration; opaque gzip decompression and raw byte hashing allowed before the v2 seal without HDF5 deserialization
failure_reporting: retain negative, interrupted, and stopped results; never relax eligibility after seeing calibration

execution.runtime: actual environment recorded and bound; not retrospectively assigned to source training
